primary_metric.name: correctly accepted absolute camera poses / all eligible positive pairs

primary_sources.title: RoMa v2: Harder Better Faster Denser Feature Matching
primary_sources.caveat: Relative angular AUC is not joint absolute reference-map pose acceptance. Published H200 batch throughput is not a two-thread CPU latency comparison. Refinement and predicted covariance already exist in this work.

primary_sources.title: RoMa-Ω: What Feed-Forward 3D Models Know About Image Matching
primary_sources.caveat: This same-paper comparison must not be combined with RoMa v2 original-paper WxBS 55.4. Different setup; no inference about project pose success.

primary_sources.title: Adapting Stereo Vision From Objects To 3D Lunar Surface Reconstruction with the StereoLunar Dataset
primary_sources.metric: separate relative rotation and translation-direction angular accuracies
primary_sources.caveat: Separate marginals; neither a joint success rate nor absolute translation within 1% of range. Pose uses 2D matches, known intrinsics and essential-matrix estimation. Scale-invariant reconstruction and simulated terrain dependence must be disclosed.

primary_sources.title: LoMa: Local Feature Matching Revisited
primary_sources.relevant_variant: LoMa-R, rotation-invariant descriptor and matcher using augmentation
primary_sources.caveat: Aerial-image relevance is stated by the authors. Do not attribute LoMa-B README scores to LoMa-R; actual project forward/geometry controls and CPU measurements remain necessary.

primary_sources.title: Geometric Foundation Model Distillation for Efficient Lunar 3D Reconstruction
primary_sources.version: ECCV 2026 author project and repository snapshot
primary_sources.caveat: Efficient lunar reconstruction already has a direct prior. Public paper PDF and downloadable pretrained student weights were not verified. Project and README student identifiers differ; report the range, not inconsistent IDs. A much smaller matcher does not establish equivalent reconstruction functionality or better pose accuracy.

primary_sources.title: Illumination Invariant Image Matching for Lunar TRN
primary_sources.verified_scope: LIMA correlation-based matching and learned illumination-invariant features, with synthetic and real experiments
primary_sources.access: Publisher abstract available through indexed primary page; full page returned HTTP403. Numerical tables not inspected.
primary_sources.caveat: Do not assign the SIW 2024 numerical figures to this 2025 paper.

primary_sources.title: Learning Illumination Invariant Features for Lunar South Pole with Deep Learning
primary_sources.benchmark: Ortho-to-Ortho, seen 180E map versus unseen 0E map
primary_sources.metric: correspondence reprojection accuracy at figure pixel thresholds; mean matches
primary_sources.verification: Page 3 rendered and visually checked; selected numeric cells belong to 3-degree elevation row, not the 1-degree histogram condition.
primary_sources.caveat: Not camera-pose recovery. Seen versus unseen terrain distinction is essential. No full figure copied into audit.

primary_sources.title: Stitching Illumination-Matched Maps: A LIMA-Based Pipeline for Robust Reference Map Generation
primary_sources.verified_scope: Author summary describes synthesizing target-lighting reference maps from images under different Sun angles.
primary_sources.access: Author primary page inspected; publisher page HTTP403. Full methods and quantitative tables not inspected.
primary_sources.caveat: A closely related prior that must be examined before claiming response-prediction novelty.

primary_sources.title: Shadow-Based Matching for Precise and Robust Absolute Self-Localization during Lunar Landings
primary_sources.verified_scope: Known-Sun DEM rendering, shadow matching and RANSAC for lunar absolute localization.
primary_sources.caveat: Shadow matching itself is prior art; numerical pose metrics are not being compared here.

primary_sources.title: Terrain Relative Navigation for Lunar Polar Roving: Exploiting Geometry, Shadows, and Planning
primary_sources.verified_scope: Geometric terrain registration, shadow features, uncertainty prediction and planning for information gain.
primary_sources.caveat: Active information selection and geometric/shadow localization are not new in themselves.

primary_sources.title: JPL Robotics: Adnan Ansar
primary_sources.verified_scope: Mapping, localization, stereo, feature matching and lunar terrain-relative navigation; establishes topic relevance, not interest in this project.
